claims.claim: Someone who has started trading as a sole trader and earns more than £1,000 needs to register for Self Assessment.
claims.quote: However, you must register for Self Assessment as a sole trader if you earn more than £1,000 in a tax year (from 6 April to 5 April).
claims.note: The text says sole traders earning more than £1,000 in a tax year must register for Self Assessment.

claims.claim: You must send a return if you are a sole trader earning more than £1,000 before expenses.
claims.quote: you were self-employed as a ‘sole trader’ and earned more than £1,000 (before taking off anything you can claim tax relief on)
claims.note: The text states the £1,000 threshold before taking off anything you can claim tax relief on.

claims.claim: You must send a return if you are a partner in a business partnership.
claims.quote: you were a partner in a business partnership
claims.note: Listed as a reason you must send a tax return.

claims.claim: You must send a return if you have Capital Gains Tax to pay.
claims.quote: you had to pay Capital Gains Tax when you sold or ‘disposed of’ something that increased in value
claims.note: Listed as a reason you must send a tax return.

claims.claim: You must send a return if you have to pay the High Income Child Benefit Charge and do not pay it through PAYE.
claims.quote: you had to pay the High Income Child Benefit Charge and do not pay it through PAYE
claims.note: Listed as a reason you must send a tax return.

claims.claim: You may also need to send a return for untaxed income such as rent, tips, commission, savings interest, dividends or foreign income.
claims.quote: You may also need to send a tax return if you have any untaxed income, such as: money from renting out property or land tips and commission savings interest dividends, including investments foreign income
claims.note: The text lists each of these untaxed income types.

claims.claim: Company directors are not automatically required to send a return.
claims.note: None of the sources mention company directors.

claims.claim: You need a National Insurance number to register for Self Assessment.
claims.quote: You’ll need a National Insurance number to register for Self Assessment.
claims.note: The text states a National Insurance number is needed to register.
